newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline steady arbitrage balances slack Europ.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline steady arbitrage balances slack Europ.

text.p: NWE gasoline prices held steady on Tuesday but thin year-end activity in Europe gave the market a softer undertone, traders said.

Transatlantic arbitrage options contined to support both barge and cargo prices with European demand thin. At least one U.S. trade house, seen buying barges this week, was thought to be putting together a cargo to take transatlantic.
Prompt barges traded $221 and $220 fob ARA. Eurograde cargo prices held steady around $221/$223 cif NWE but only light buying interest was seen from Poland for Q1 quotas.
